title: Punugulu
description: Andhra deep fried fritters made from leftover dosa batter with onion, green chilli and ginger, crisp outside and fluffy inside.
steps: Mix the dosa batter with the onion, green chilli, ginger, cumin seeds, curry leaves, coriander leaves and salt.
If the batter is loose, add the rice flour so it falls from the spoon in thick ribbons.
Heat the oil in a kadai on medium heat until a drop of batter rises immediately.
Drop small spoonfuls of batter into the oil and fry in batches, turning, for 4 to 5 minutes until deep golden.
Drain on paper and serve hot with coconut or ginger chutney.
